paragraphs: I carried out an assignment as an independent technical consultant for Vidya Health Ltd from April to November 2020. This work, covered by a confidentiality agreement, concerned the development of an automated epifluorescence microscope.
Since 2023, I have also occasionally carried out independent consulting, training and technical integration assignments. These activities are currently paused.
